name: Dada Vibe Connector (Logic Pro MCP)
description: Local MCP server for Apple Logic Pro 12 & 13 on Mac: write and edit MIDI, load instruments, set plug-in parameters in Hz, dB and ms, draw automation and mix from Claude Desktop, ChatGPT for Mac or VS Code with GitHub Copilot. Requires the Dada Vibe Connector macOS app (7-day free trial, then a one-time licence).
author: Dada Vibe
